proposal.explanation: Change rtl/pulse.v:6 to retain the previous sampled signal_in while leaving the enable gate and reset behavior unchanged.
proposal.unified_diff:
--- a/rtl/pulse.v
+++ b/rtl/pulse.v
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 always @(posedge clk) begin
     if (rst) begin previous <= 1'b0; pulse_out <= 1'b0; end
     else begin
-        previous <= enable;
+        previous <= signal_in;
         pulse_out <= enable && signal_in && !previous;
     end
 end
proposal.expected_effect: A high signal_in produces a pulse only when the preceding sampled signal_in was low and enable is high.
risks: Behavior changes when signal_in transitions while enable is low; the reference indicates history should still update, but independent validation has not run on this patch.
